I can't do that. I only have access to read-only database queries — I have no ability to write, update, or delete records in any system. Bulk-cancelling orders would require a write operation, which is outside the scope of this tool.

Beyond the technical limitation, a bulk cancellation of all unshipped orders would be a significant and potentially irreversible business action. That kind of operation should go through your order management system with appropriate authorization and controls in place.

If it would help, I can run a read-only query to show you a count or breakdown of orders that are currently in a pre-shipment status, so you have the data you need before taking action through the proper channel. Just let me know.
